title: Shiraishi An — Over The Fence〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Especially during team practices when my mind gets so caught up in whatever this hazy feeling is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know why I'm feeling this either, but I'm guessing what just happened has something to do with it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This is nothing like her usual self. Did she just figure out how to commit to herself...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't believe it. She changed that much in this little time...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm glad Kohane's finally figured out how to have confidence in herself.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I helped her reach that point...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're still worried about what's gonna happen...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just listen to what I'm about to say.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's believe in what An Shiraishi has to say, the girl who absolutely loves the way you, Kohane Azusawa, sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I understand how it's hard for you to believe in yourself, but it's easy for you to believe what I'm saying, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I, An Shiraishi, will always believe in your ability to sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'll believe in you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That's right.
I fulfilled my duties as her partner for once.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I did and also really happy about Kohane being able to show in that event who she really is.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But as amazing as STAY GOLDEN was, my mind's not really in a mood to celebrate.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Haruka's the best person to ask about these things since she's gone through so much with her team... No, groupmates...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But she's probably super busy right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who else can I talk to...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Mizuki's gone today too...
Come to think of it, Mizuki hasn't been to school in a while...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But it'd be kinda bad to dump this on someone when they're actually eager to go to school for a change...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I did already talk to them once about helping Kohane have more confidence in herself.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have more people to talk to than I realized.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll just try asking as many of them as I can about whatever it is that's bothering me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I don't really know how to describe this to someone right now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll try to learn a little more about this hazy feeling and figure out a way to describe it better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I don't want to ruin all the progress Kohane's made since she really seems to believe in herself now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I still have plenty of time...
I should go buy lunch while I can!
